title: Round 51 (F357): Quest window id11 render detail - 0x447470 (entry stride 0x104, 19-line cap, 0x45E0C0 measure 0xC8=200px gate, colors 0x1919C8 selected/0x19197D normal, row = line*3+0x12) + sim quest list wired (browser-verified)
objective: Decode the quest window (id11, Ctrl+D) text-list renderer details and wire them into the simulator.
question: How does the original quest window render its text list (stride, cap, measure gate, colors)?
method: Capstone disassembly of 0x447470 (quest paint); sim app.js wiring; browser verification.

quest_paint_0x447470.measure: 0x45E0C0 measure line; width > 0xC8=200 -> wrap/scroll path (0x44755C repne scasb string length)

sim_wiring.fill: window.quest renders 5 quest lines (19 cap), left=0x41+24, top=0x12+i*22, colors 0x1919C8/0x19197D, evidence desc
sim_wiring.browser: D key opens quest; 5 lines; first = ★ 主线：拜见国王 color rgb(25,25,200) = 0x1919C8

audit_vs_exe.F331: entry stride 0x104 shared with skill list confirmed

contrast.quest_vs_skill: both use 0x104 stride text lists; quest = 2 colors (selected/normal) + 200px gate; skill = category tabs + detail page
contrast.quest_vs_chat: quest = server-pushed quest list (0x104 stride); chat = message ring (0x408 node)

verdict: Quest window render decoded (primary-bytes): 0x447470 text list with 0x104 stride, 19-line cap, 0x45E0C0 measure 200px gate, selected/normal colors 0x1919C8/0x19197D, row = line*3+0x12. Sim quest list wired and browser-verified.
evidence_level_note: All offsets, colors and gates read directly from MIR3.EXE bytes; sim quest content is demo (server-pushed at runtime).
reproduce: img.disasm(0x447470, 0x400); open sim; press D; observe quest window colors/rows
notes: quest line width gate 0xC8=200px (0x44754D cmp edx,0xC8) - longer lines wrap
row stride = line*3 (0x447618 lea eax,[ecx+ecx*2+0x12]) = 12px per line + 0x12 base

detail_geometry.panel_position_expression: x = window.x+0x41 (0x00447E39 add edx,0x41); y = window.y+0x126 (0x00447E32 add ecx,0x126)
detail_geometry.panel_draw_call: 0x00447E02 push 0x2C1 -> 0x466130 SelectFrame -> 0x45FD50(0x8AB7A8, x, y, frame_w, frame_h, 0xFFFF, 0xFFFF)
detail_geometry.text_origin_expression: x = window.x+0x50 (0x00447F0C add ecx,0x50); y = window.y+0x136 + row*15 (0x00447F02 lea eax,[ecx+edx+0x136], ecx = row*15 from 0x00447EFC/0x00447EFF)
detail_geometry.note: Recovered 2026-09-29 by re-disassembling 0x00447D58-0x00447F90; earlier the value existed only as prose in UI_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md, and GodotClient/Controls/QuestDialog.cs referenced a non-existent `detail_geometry` key. Panel size cross-checked against GameInter F705 header = 204x76.

list_row_geometry.y_expression: window.y+0x5A+15*line: 0x00447618 lea eax,[ecx+ecx*2+0x12] (=line*3+0x12), 0x00447622 lea eax,[eax+eax*4] (=x5) -> (line*3+0x12)*5 = line*15+90, 0x00447625 add eax,edx (window.y)
list_row_geometry.selected_color: 0x1919C8 (+0x51 variant 0x191A19) via 0x004475F7 and al,0x51 / add eax,0x1919C8
list_row_geometry.normal_color: 0x19197D (+0xCE variant 0x191A4B) via 0x00447604 and al,0xCE / add eax,0x19197D
list_row_geometry.color_format: 0x00BBGGRR (same convention as skill window 0x0A320A dark green / 0x96C8FA light blue): 0x1919C8 = RGB(200,25,25), 0x19197D = RGB(125,25,25)
list_row_geometry.correction: 2026-09-29: the earlier prose note 'row = line*3+0x12' (also in the title/verdict) omitted the following `lea eax,[eax+eax*4]` (x5). The rendered row pitch is 15px, y base = win.y+90, not 3px. GodotClient/Controls/QuestDialog.cs legacy mode still renders the MODERN grouped list (x=8/18/28, gold/white) inside the F700 frame -> recorded as CONFIRMED_DIFFERENCE (see GODOT_WINDOW_PARITY_MATRIX_2026-09-29.md).
